_comment: Which part of the APK each file and dex class belongs to (tools/size/apksize.py, docs/size.md). Read from app/kiosk/build.gradle.kts and the imports in app/kiosk/src/main and app/libs (2026-11-13). The longest matching dex prefix wins; a class nothing matches is core. A library is counted in a pane's own total only when that pane alone uses it. A pane's `assets` are paths outside assets/panes/<id>/ that are its own (the radio bundle, which the app and release.yml expect at assets/radio-bundle/). A pane's `dex` lists its package and the classes elsewhere that only it uses (read 2026-11-13 from their users).

engine._why: GeckoView: its Java and native code, and omni.ja (Gecko's own JS, CSS and resources).

bouncycastle._why: app/libs/esphome-api (Noise) brings it; Sendspin's encryption uses it too

media3._why: audio playback (voice/); GeckoView ships the same version (build.gradle.kts)

assist._why: VoiceAssistantController.kt (esphome/) declares these three, used only by voice/

radio._why: the signed radio bundle, which the release adds to armeabi-v7a (release.yml, RadioBundle.kt)

time-zone._why: TimeZoneKeeper is used only by TimeZonePane
